## `describe_model` {#tool-describe-model}

**Describe the model** · read only

Tables with their columns and row counts, datasets and fields, relationships, metrics with their SQL, and dashboards. Read this first: names in queries are the ones it lists.

No arguments.

## `preview_table` {#tool-preview-table}

**Preview a table** · read only

The newest rows of a table.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | `20` |  |
| `table` | string | **required** |  |


## `query_metrics` {#tool-query-metrics}

**Query metrics** · read only

Metrics grouped by fields (`dataset.field`, time fields with a grain: day, week, month, quarter, year), under filters (`in` a list, `from`/`to` a half-open range, or `contains` a text, for a string field, ignoring the case of ASCII letters), sorted and limited. The body of POST /v1/query.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dimensions` | list of object with `field`, `grain` |  |  |
| `filters` | list of object with `contains`, `field`, `from`, `in`, `to` |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  |  |
| `metrics` | list of string | **required** |  |
| `sort` | list of object with `column`, `desc` |  |  |


## `read_rows` {#tool-read-rows}

**Read the newest rows** · read only

The newest rows of a table that pass filters, newest first: the fields to show (`dataset.field`, of one table and the tables it reaches), and filters as in query_metrics. A `contains` filter on a log line's text finds the lines that mention something. The body of POST /v1/rows.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` | list of string | **required** |  |
| `filters` | list of object with `contains`, `field`, `from`, `in`, `to` |  |  |
| `limit` | integer | `100` |  |


## `get_config` {#tool-get-config}

**Get the config** · read only

Every config file of the current version, and the version: the base for plan_change and apply_change. Needs the admin token.

No arguments.

## `plan_change` {#tool-plan-change}

**Plan a change** · read only

What setting or removing these files would do: problems (with file and line), and every change with its class (safe, rebuild, destructive). Changes nothing. Needs the admin token.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_version` | integer |  | Defaults to the current version. |
| `files` | map of string | **required** | Config files to set (path → YAML text) or remove (path → null). Paths: tidepool.yaml, model.ossie.yaml, tables/&lt;name&gt;.yaml, dashboards/&lt;name&gt;.yaml. |


## `apply_change` {#tool-apply-change}

**Apply a change**

Applies the change if its class is one agents may apply on their own (tidepool.yaml `agents.auto_apply`, safe by default); otherwise it waits for a person's approval and the result says which change to point them to. Needs the admin token.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_version` | integer | **required** |  |
| `files` | map of string | **required** | Config files to set (path → YAML text) or remove (path → null). Paths: tidepool.yaml, model.ossie.yaml, tables/&lt;name&gt;.yaml, dashboards/&lt;name&gt;.yaml. |
| `summary` | string |  | Who or what made it, for the history. |


## `ingest_rows` {#tool-ingest-rows}

**Write rows**

Writes rows (JSON objects, column → value) to a table; visible when the call returns. Needs the ingest token.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | list of object | **required** |  |
| `table` | string | **required** |  |
